# The KAT corpus: real upstream dss-xades test fixtures, one per line, optionally followed by
# a tab and a comma-separated list of detached documents to hand the detached resolver.
#
# Paths are relative to dss-xades/src/test/resources and are reproduced verbatim under
# testdata/corpus. Selection covers every reference-processing feature the port implements:
# same-document "" and "#id" fragments, #xpointer(/) and #xpointer(id('x')), detached file
# references, the enveloped-signature transform, all four canonicalization transforms the
# corpus uses, base64, ds:XPath and XPath Filter 2.0 (intersect/subtract/union), ds:Manifest
# references, and the RSA/ECDSA/RSASSA-PSS signature methods.

validation/xsw/XSW-enveloped-fake-signedProperties.xml
validation/xsw/original.xml

# The exhaustive tail: EVERY remaining file under dss-xades/src/test/resources that names
# the XML-DSIG namespace and that Apache Santuario 3.0.6 can load, up to 300 kB. The curated
# list above says what each fixture is FOR; this list exists so that no upstream signature
# is quietly outside the known-answer corpus, including the deliberately broken ones the
# upstream suite keeps around (xsw/*, *-tampered-*, *-invalid-*, dss-signed-altered-*).
#
# Two upstream files are excluded because Santuario cannot load them at all, so there is no
# answer to know:
#   validation/malformed-xades.xml           MalformedByteSequenceException (invalid UTF-8)
#   validation/xades-with-dtd-injection.xml  SAXParseException (DOCTYPE, disallowed)
# Both are covered instead by xmldsig_test.go, which requires the Go parser to refuse them.
#
# Five upstream files are excluded by the 300 kB cap; they are multi-megabyte trusted lists
# whose signatures repeat shapes already covered here (XAdESLTA.xml, OJ_L_2016_294_FULL.xml,
# dss-1647_OJ_L_2018_109_FULL.xml, Signature-X-HR_FIN-1.xml, OJ_C_2017_173_FULL.xml).
